title: Tidewater Horizon
meta_description: Tidewater Horizon offers beachfront Gulf views, resort pools, spa, and steps to Pier Park on Panama City Beach's quiet west end.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Tidewater Horizon, a beachfront retreat where emerald Gulf views unfold endlessly from your private balcony and the rhythm of the waves sets the pace for your stay. Positioned along the sought-after west end of Panama City Beach, this elevated condo pairs front-row ocean scenery with full-scale resort amenities---offering the best of both relaxation and entertainment.

Step inside to a bright, open-concept living space designed for gathering. Natural light pours in from the balcony doors, creating an easy flow between the living area, dining space for six, and fully equipped kitchen. Whether you're preparing a fresh seafood dinner, sharing takeout after a beach day, or lingering over morning coffee with the water in view, the layout makes group time feel effortless. A washer and dryer add everyday convenience, especially for extended stays.

The home comfortably accommodates up to 11 guests across three well-appointed bedrooms and a flexible bunk nook. The primary suite features a king bed and private ensuite bath, creating a peaceful place to unwind. A second bedroom offers two queen beds and its own ensuite---ideal for families or friends sharing the space---while the third bedroom includes another king bed with ensuite access for added privacy. The twin-over-double bunk nook adds a fun and practical sleeping option, perfect for kids or extra guests.

Beyond your front door, the resort experience truly sets this stay apart. Spend sun-soaked afternoons at the beachfront outdoor pool or enjoy year-round swims in the indoor heated pool. Relax and recharge in the Roman spa, sauna, or steam room. An on-site movie theater, arcade-filled game room, and fitness center ensure entertainment for every age and energy level, while the Tiki Bar, on-site dining, BBQ grills, and picnic areas make it easy to settle in without ever leaving the property.

When you're ready to explore, you're just minutes from Pier Park's waterfront dining, shopping, and entertainment, as well as scenic sunset walks along Russell-Fields Pier. Gulf World Marine Park offers family-friendly adventure nearby, and the west-end location provides a quieter stretch of sand while keeping you close to everything Panama City Beach is known for.

At Tidewater Horizon, the beach is steps away, the views are uninterrupted, and every detail is designed to make group travel feel seamless.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Guest Registration is required for all guests. Guest registration includes parking passes and RFID wristbands. Failure to register will result in being denied check-in.

Parking Details:
- Parking garage available (2 passes provided at the registration desk). Vehicles must not exceed 7'2" height.
- Additional costs include Tidewater parking pass and wristband fee. Wristbands are given to all guests 12 and up and must be worn at all times while on the property.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit Number/BTR: 72036
